question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"away."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Away" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The phrase **"carried away" **means to be so excited that one is no longer in control of one's behavior. (इतना उत्तेजित होना कि व्यक्ति का अपने व्यवहार पर नियंत्रण न रह जाए)
 
 
• **Example**: *They allowed themselves to be **carried away**__ by fear.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

The room looked as though a __hurricane__ had swept through it. The storm had blown __open__ the French doors during the night, and the wind and the rain had wreaked havoc, __scattering__ everything before it. A few __loose__ pages of the report lay on the wet rug, but the rest of the pages had obviously been carried __**away**__ by the wind. 

 **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "over"**, indicates a position above or higher than something. (किसी वस्‍तु से सीधे ऊपर (उसे न छूते हुए))
 
• **Option 2, "nearer"**, indicates a closer distance or proximity to something. (किसी चीज़ से अधिक दूरी या निकटता)
 
• **Option 4, "of"**, is a preposition used to indicate possession or relationship between two things. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍वामित्‍ववाला, से संबंधित या उसका भाग; का)
